summary: Restoration Shaman has especially relevant poison cleansing and personal snare-removal utility in Altar of Fangs.
recommendations: Talent Poison Cleansing Totem for Mass Envenom and Lasher Toxin recovery.
Use Spirit Walk to remove the slowing components of Paralyzing Shots, Regurgitate, and Toxic Atrophy from yourself.
Do not allocate dungeon-specific points to Improved Purify Spirit, Tremor Totem, or Purge solely for the mechanics covered by this note.
Keep Wind Shear available for priority casts, especially the three successive Toxic Atrophy casts.

provenance.description: Original build-scoped summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Restoration Shaman Midnight Season 2 dungeon guide.
